fundamental.text: Raw sugar is 2.27¢/lb above hydrous-ethanol parity in Brazil, so mills favour sugar in the mix (more supply). Sugar in BRL at R$2,275/t (56th pct of 5 yrs). Desk read: Nothing new out of Brazil this afternoon; Mar is holding about 18.40, above the 18.35–18.38 band, on short covering with crude. The weak real still favours mill hedging and sugar-heavy mixes, so the bounce is technical rather than a tighter Brazil balance.
